topics.description: The FBI has taken over the investigation into the fatal shooting of a woman by an ICE agent in Minneapolis, blocking Minnesota law enforcement from accessing evidence. This has raised concerns about the transparency and accountability of the investigation.
topics.reason: FBI takes over investigation, blocking Minnesota law enforcement

topics.description: Allegations of fraud by Minnesota Governor Tim Walz and Attorney General Keith Ellison have surfaced, with the ACLJ filing FOIA requests to expose the scandal. This has raised concerns about the integrity of the state's government and the potential for corruption.
topics.reason: ACLJ files FOIA requests to expose Walz's Minnesota fraud scandal
